paper_title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for   Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
caption: Results of the shared Top-6 routed experts in two independent samples of a task. The x-axis represents the sample size, and the y-axis shows the shared Top-6 routed experts averaged by model layers.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the shared Top-6 routed experts for two independent samples, with the y-axis representing “Shared Samples for Two Experts” on a linear scale ranging from approximately 2.5 to 5.8. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and displays values from 2^10 to 2^19, with tick intervals of 2^1, indicating increments of 2048. The data is displayed as a series of colored lines, including a red line representing “Intent” which initially values at approximately 2.8 at 2^10 and approaches 5.5 at 2^19, a blue line representing “Summary” which begins at approximately 3.8 at 2^10 and reaches 5.3 at 2^19, a yellow line representing “Law” which starts at approximately 3.2 at 2^10 and stabilizes around 4.8 at 2^19, a black line representing “Translation” beginning at approximately 3.5 at 2^10 and decreasing to 4.4 at 2^19, and a green line representing “Math” which values at approximately 3.9 at 2^10 and reaches 5.1 at 2^19.
